title: OEC v2 Method x Resource matrix – topic and payload columns
description: Format of oec/spec/matrix/method-resource.yaml (ADR-0018, C-012 plan section 4): one row per Method x Resource/service combination with the allowed topic form (C-018) and, for allowed rows, the payload columns (C-028). Cross-checked against topic/topic.abnf, the requirements and the payload vectors by 'spectool lint'.

rule.description: ABNF rule of the complete topic.

filter_rule.description: ABNF rule of the Filter (all levels after the Source).

payload.description: Payload columns of an allowed combination (C-028); rows of a resource whose area is still planned may omit them (checked by 'spectool lint').

class_id.description: predefined: DataSetClassId of MG A2 in the NetworkMessage (REQ-MSG-010/011); publisher-defined: the publisher's own if all DataSetMessages belong to one class (REQ-MSG-011); if-known: only if the requester knows it (REQ-MSG-011); in-metadata: in the MetaData (REQ-MSG-012); none: no DataSetClassId.

writer_id.description: publisher: one DataSetWriterId per resource, Source and Filter, assigned by the publisher (REQ-MSG-021); list: one common DataSetWriterId for all entries of the list (REQ-MSG-021); addressed: the DataSetWriterId of the addressed DataSet (REQ-BUS-010); none: no resource DataSetMessage; action: reserved DataSetWriterId of the common service (REQ-ACT-019).

content.description: none: no resource DataSetMessage; datasets: any number of resource DataSetMessages; single: exactly one; metadata-empty: MetaData {}; metadata-filled: complete DataSetMetaDataType; action-request/action-response: Action message (area ACT).

answer.description: none: not answered; pub: Pub on the corresponding topic with ReplyTo (REQ-BUS-003); status-and-pub: Status event and, if successful, Pub of the changed object (REQ-RES-EVENT-005, REQ-BUS-006); status: Status event only, nothing published (REQ-BUS-007); status-and-rest: Status event and Pub of the remaining entries (REQ-RES-SUBLIST-015); reply: Reply with an ActionResponse (area ACT).
